svg.aria-label: Exposure gains and recording limits in the same counting model. Left: ideal signal-to-noise ratios for background factors 1 and 0.25. Right: conditions above the white contour exceed 3000 total peak counts. Color represents the unclipped counting model; the contour identifies where recorded values begin to diverge from it.
